on_game_start_after_lobby = {
    on_actions = {
        on_kCAFG_start_late
    }
}

on_kCAFG_start_late = {
    effect = {
		debug_log = "Kei CAFG - On Action - Late Start"

        E_kCAFG_setup_all_counties = yes
        trigger_event = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0001
        trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_on_counties_setup_finished }
    }
}

kCAFG_on_counties_setup_finished = {}
